title: Guess the Gibberish
shortDesc: Guess IT-related words from invented gibberish across multiple difficulty levels.
longDesc:
Guess IT-related words from invented gibberish across multiple difficulty levels. Built with Java for Android Studio.

Game Features:
• Multiple difficulty levels (Easy, Medium, Hard)
• IT-related word categories
• Hints and timer system
• Score tracking and high scores
• Sound effects and animations
• Offline play support
